top_signals.title: Ukraine confirms it sank Russian corvette in Libyan port
top_signals.summary: Ukraine was behind the explosive sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury in the Libyan port of Benghazi over the weekend, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, and the country’s military released accompanying videos.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ‘Worst COP ever’: Climate talks collapse after draft deal fails to include fossil fuels
top_signals.summary: Governments and campaigners rejected the "cover decision" drafted at the U.N.'s climate summit, COP31, on Sunday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
top_signals.summary: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
